common_processes: Lead and enquiry intake from website and referrals
Client document chasing and follow-up reminders
common_pain_points: Hours spent chasing clients for documents and information
Manual email triage consuming senior staff time
Repetitive proposal and engagement letter drafting
Meeting notes not actioned or tracked consistently
CRM not kept up to date with client interactions
Slow follow-up on leads and enquiries
Invoice follow-up taking too much time
Document filing inconsistent and hard to retrieve

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Classify incoming emails by urgency and topic; draft suggested responses for routine queries; staff reviews, edits and sends
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Staff reviews all drafted responses before sending; legal/financial advice emails require senior review

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Automated reminders for outstanding documents; escalate overdue items; track receipt in CRM
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Staff reviews reminder content and approves sending; no automatic escalation without review

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Pre-fill templates from client and engagement data; staff customises and approves
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Senior staff must review and approve all proposals and engagement letters

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Transcribe meeting notes into structured action items with owners and deadlines; sync to task management
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Meeting chair reviews and confirms action items before distribution

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Log client interactions, update deal stages, set follow-up reminders based on email and meeting activity
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Staff reviews auto-logged interactions weekly for accuracy

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Classify and prioritise incoming leads; draft initial response; assign to appropriate team member
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Team lead reviews classification and approves response before sending

human_approval_points: All legal advice must come from qualified legal professionals
All financial advice must come from qualified financial professionals
Any commitment on behalf of the firm
data_sensitivity: Medium to high. Client identity documents, financial information, and legal matters require strict handling. Legal professional privilege may apply.
not_recommended_for_automation: Generating and sending final legal opinions without lawyer review
Generating and sending final financial advice without qualified professional review
Direct debit or payment authorisation without approval
Any communication that could create legal obligations without review
Sharing client information between matters without consent
onsite_discovery_questions: Walk us through how a new client enquiry becomes an engaged client
How are client documents currently collected and filed?
What is the email triage process — who handles what?
How are meeting notes captured and actioned?
What is the proposal preparation process from start to send?
How is the CRM kept up to date and by whom?
What compliance or regulatory requirements affect your document handling?
pilot_scope_examples: AI-draft routine email responses for one practice area
Automated document chasing for one client cohort
Auto-generate meeting action items for one team
Lead enquiry classification and initial response draft
cannot_promise: Compliance with legal professional privilege requirements
Integration with all legal practice management systems
Specific time savings without pilot measurement
That automated drafts will be error-free
legal_financial_constraints: Legal and financial professional advice must always involve qualified human professionals. AI can assist with drafting, research and organisation but the final professional opinion, advice or recommendation must come from a licensed professional. This is non-negotiable.
reduction_range_assumption: 20%–45% of current manual hours on identified workflows
